sources.title: Piracy monthly report November 2023
sources.text: While anchored, an AB crew and OS were preparing the mooring rope at the aft station when they were confronted by four perpetrators armed with knives/machetes who boarded the ship from the stern. The AB was taken into custody by the perpetrators while the OS managed to escape and alerted the duty officer. When the general alarm was sounded, the perpetrator released the AB, and fled via a small wooden boat. A search was conducted by the ship crew and no perpetrator was found onboard.
